## Who may be drafted to

Returns the prospects that pass every guardrail in the local store — not suppressed, has an email, not already drafted, within today's cap — plus the sender block and unsubscribe line the email must carry, and each prospect's own UTM-tagged guide-page link.

Just as important, it returns everyone who was EXCLUDED and why. Report those; never draft to a prospect that is not in `eligible`.

Pass `campaignId` when the user is working a named push: it sets the utm_campaign on every link and carries the offer through. Without it the links fall back to a generic `utm_campaign=outreach`, so clicks cannot be attributed to that push.

'&campaignId=' + encodeURIComponent($('Validate Draftable Input').item.json.campaignId) : '') + ($('Validate Draftable Input').item.json.listName !== '' ?
